8.12. iLock_Geography.geo_attributes¶

The module defines a number of extra geography attributes.

var RY_OBJECT_NAME:
 PiSPEC instance attribute that keeps the name of the railyard object it was created from.
type RY_OBJECT_NAME:
 str
var RY_TYPE_NAME:
 PiSPEC instance attribute that keeps the name of the user type of the railyard object it was created from.
type RY_TYPE_NAME:
 str
var LAYOUT_EDITOR_OBJECT:
 Railyard-PiSPEC attribute that is set to True if the corresponding railyard object is created by the layout editor.
type LAYOUT_EDITOR_OBJECT:
 str
var NODE_X_POS:Node coordinate attribute that keeps the X position.
type NODE_X_POS:
 str
var NODE_Y_POS:Node coordinate attribute that keeps the Y position.
type NODE_Y_POS:
 str
var X_COORD:Object coordinate attribute that keeps the X position.
type X_COORD:str
var Y_COORD:Object coordinate attribute that keeps the Y position.
type Y_COORD:str
var RY_PATH_START_OBJECT:
 PiSPEC instance attribute that keeps the name of the start railyard object of a path.
type RY_PATH_START_OBJECT:
 str
var RY_PATH_END_OBJECT:
 PiSPEC instance attribute that keeps the name of the end railyard object of a path.
type RY_PATH_END_OBJECT:
 str
